review:
Scroll of Adventure is a 2016 BGaming book slot with five lines and a single symbol that is both wild and scatter. Three or more scatters trigger 10 free spins with a random expanding symbol, and the free spins can be retriggered.

BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the RTP is a strong 97.1%. Free spins are frequent for a book game, arriving about once every 98 spins. It's a minimal version of the classic book formula with excellent value.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 98 spins on average)
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
